skala_keep_existing_lambda_and_anonymous_function_parens_arrangement #

Keep the existing arrangement of a lambda's or an anonymous method's parentheses. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-30 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6 on constructs/preservation/lambda-parens.cs, with the author's break inside the lambda's parentheses: THE C# FORMATTER DOES NOT ANSWER TO THIS KEY. It is flat at true and at false, in both spellings; what rejoins the parentheses is skala_keep_existing_declaration_parens_arrangement = false, and with that key at false this one still changes nothing in either direction. The same shape as remove_this_qualifier: a documented editorconfig property the C# formatter is not wired to. Skala answered to it — BreakPlan.DeclarationKeeps routed a lambda's parameter list here — which is why the sweep read SPURIOUS. One key now governs every parameter list. SK-DIV-0093.
